llcFilesWith: West Virginia Secretary of State, Business & Licensing Division (Application for Trade Name (DBA), Form NR-3, filed online through the One Stop Business Portal or on paper)
soleProprietorFilesWith: West Virginia Secretary of State (the same trade name registry, but on Form TN-1 and with no filing fee; the Secretary of State directs individuals, sole proprietorships, and general partnerships to the West Virginia State Tax Department to check name availability)
feeBasis: The Secretary of State fee to register a trade name is $25 for a corporation, LLC, limited partnership, limited liability partnership, voluntary association, or business trust, and is stated as the filing fee on Form NR-3 (rev. 07/2026). An individual, sole proprietorship, or general partnership pays no filing fee. A $1 online processing fee applies to all online filings, and expedite service costs extra.
renewalRule: A trade name registration stays in effect until the owner files a certificate of withdrawal on discontinuing use of the name (W. Va. Code § 47-8-4(c)); there is no periodic renewal.
protectionNote: A trade name registration is notice rather than a trademark and confers no exclusive right; a business that wants exclusive rights registers a trademark or service mark. It is screened on the way in, though: W. Va. Code § 47-8-4(a)(2) requires the trade name to be distinguishable from the name of every other registered entity and from every reserved or registered name, and the Secretary of State applies a second filter on top of that, refusing a name that shows a "likelihood of confusion" with a name already on record.
searchNote: Registered trade names appear in the Secretary of State's Business Organizations Search. The office also offers an informal availability check by telephone through the Business Division before filing.
notes: West Virginia registers trade names centrally with the Secretary of State (W. Va. Code ch. 47, art. 8), but the article splits by filer type: § 47-8-4 is the section that governs an LLC, corporation, limited partnership, limited liability partnership, business trust, or voluntary association, while § 47-8-2 covers individuals, sole proprietorships, and general partnerships. An LLC therefore files Form NR-3 for $25; the TN-1 form is the individual and sole proprietorship route and carries no fee. Section 47-8-4(e) subjects an LLC's trade name to W. Va. Code § 31B-1-105(b), (c), and (d), so the LLC naming rules, the distinguishability test, and the consent and merger escapes all apply to the trade name as well. A registration does not expire and is ended by filing a certificate of withdrawal under § 47-8-4(c). Willful failure to comply with either § 47-8-2 or § 47-8-4 is a misdemeanor under § 47-8-5, punishable by a fine of $25 to $100, up to thirty days in the county jail, or both. The office directs entity filers to its own Business Organizations Search for availability and directs individuals and sole proprietorships to the State Tax Department instead; registration with the Tax Department is not a stated prerequisite to an LLC's trade name filing.
